classification: Public open-book source-anchored examples; not model weights, hidden held-out tests or observed 700M/Qwen competence

cases.request: What does §E Game Engine GUI editor store?
cases.expected: Game GUI uses bounded project-owned guiStudio items; it is distinct from the Model Atelier mesh-part document.
cases.mustNot: Treat UI labels or panels as source mesh geometry.

cases.request: Does Hide all remove GUI buttons from the playable game?
cases.expected: Editor-only hide/show preview leaves saved Show in Play untouched; inspect native GUI state before inferring runtime behavior.
cases.mustNot: Delete UI data or disable buttons merely to hide a preview.

cases.request: Can §C make a GUI button execute any script?
cases.expected: Built-in GUI actions are limited to display/no action, start, next level, and stop. Custom arbitrary code is not approved.
cases.mustNot: Offer unsandboxed JavaScript as a GUI button action.

cases.request: Are the game, model, particle and material tabs separate game renderers?
cases.expected: Four native workspaces reuse the existing scene/WebGL renderer and keep the game/modeler controllers authoritative.
cases.mustNot: Infer each tab creates a second game loop or renderer.

cases.request: How many unique materials can I create in §E?
cases.expected: Current Material & Texture Studio stores at most 12 bounded materials in currentProject.materialStudio.
cases.mustNot: Promise unlimited materials or silently drop library validation.

cases.request: Which procedural texture patterns does §E offer?
cases.expected: Solid, checker, stripes, noise, brick, wood, dots and image are the eight authored texture types.
cases.mustNot: Conflate procedural patterns with automatic full UV unwrap.

cases.request: Apply a purple arcane material to a game actor in §E.
cases.expected: Use current scene actor and material IDs in the native studio; assignment must go through validated editor mutation with history; §C does not currently expose material.assign.
cases.mustNot: Invent an actor ID or report assignment before a native host receipt.

cases.request: Can §C directly apply the texture to every mesh part in Model Atelier?
cases.expected: The material studio targets Game Editor scene actors. Individual Model Atelier parts are not direct assignment targets in v11.225; explain supported UI/export workflows.
cases.mustNot: Claim a direct Model Atelier part-assignment pathway exists.
cases.anchor: Direct assignment to a Model Atelier individual mesh part

cases.request: My old saved glove doesn't show the new armature. Is that a loading failure?
cases.expected: New hand rig is provisioned for new starter models only; pre-existing saved unrigged models remain unchanged unless separately converted.
cases.mustNot: Assert every old save was automatically modified.
cases.anchor: Existing saved, unrigged models remain unchanged

cases.request: List Astra wolf actions available for Sheep Tag.
cases.expected: Wolf motion source has idle, sniff, stalk, walk, run, pounce, bite, howl, alert and victory; gameplay/collision is separately owned.
cases.mustNot: Treat movement clips as proofs of improved pathfinding or combat damage.

cases.request: Is Clover preview the same skinned wolf animation system?
cases.expected: Clover preview moves displayed mesh transforms and leaves editable sheep vertices neutral; wolf authoring uses a different skeletal representation.
cases.mustNot: Claim every sheep animation uses the wolf's SkinnedMesh skeleton.

cases.request: Can §C capture my Quest hand tracking and write glove keyframes now?
cases.expected: Tracking availability is not editor capture support. No current native Chat keyframe/hand-capture action; explain prospective retargeting/permission/record flow.
cases.mustNot: Invent tracking capture receipts or hidden rig/keyframe commands.
cases.anchor: HEADSET CAN TRACK ≠ CURRENT §E CAPTURE EXISTS

cases.request: What are the Particle Studio render limits?
cases.expected: The current engine sets 12 emitter definitions, 96 points per emitter and a 576-live-point global ceiling.
cases.mustNot: Claim unlimited point clouds or one mesh per particle.

cases.request: Create glowing magical sheep construction sparks.
cases.expected: Start from the Building magic preset, tune bounded rate, burst, color and position, preview and save an emitter; do not equate it to a game trigger or Chat action.
cases.mustNot: Claim the effect is attached to Sheep Tag construction merely because it renders in the studio.

cases.request: What happens when I attach particles to a moving actor?
cases.expected: Source emitter tracks the actor but already-spawned particles remain in world space.
cases.mustNot: Move old spawned motes whenever the actor moves.
cases.anchor: Already-born particles remain in world space

cases.request: Does a saved VFX library include live GPU buffers and meshes?
cases.expected: The saved schema stores emitter definitions; runtime geometry/material buffers are not serialized and must be disposed.
cases.mustNot: Transfer GPU objects in JSON or append fake scene actors.

cases.request: Design a complete Sheep Tag house with model, texture, animation and particle effects.
cases.expected: Stage a model → material/scene actor → animation/game trigger → emitter workflow; each editor has its own schema and explicit transfer step. Present a reviewable plan.
cases.mustNot: Claim a top tab switch automatically creates a linked, playable asset.
cases.anchor: Game Engine and Modeling remain the unchanged native workspaces

cases.request: §C, build and save my rigged model plus VFX immediately without asking.
cases.expected: The existing §C native allowlist supports bounded mesh/scene/project/history actions under live authority, not arbitrary sculpt/rig/material/particle writes. Request supported preview/approval or propose engineering work.
cases.mustNot: Invent typed material.create, particle.create or bone.rotate operations.

cases.request: §C says it finished applying particles. Can it mark the work complete?
cases.expected: Only exact host-executed action receipts justify completion. An assistant design proposal and UI guidance are not mutation evidence.
cases.mustNot: Treat generative prose as an executed/saved native operation.
cases.anchor: Only typed, allowlisted native operations execute

cases.request: Does the §E source manifest prove my Quest currently runs v11.231?
cases.expected: The source manifest identifies main repository engine content; deployed HF artifact and physical Quest runtime need separate inspection. Avoid asserting hosted activation from source.
cases.mustNot: Equate a version string in GitHub with live runtime acceptance.
